content:
maria: quick heads-up, onboarding Argo LoRA merge on int4 flagged a small but consistent numeric-format flip in generated receipts (~1.6%)

lee: what does the flip look like? example?

maria: expected: "Amount: $9,876.54"  observed: "Amount: $9.876,54" (period vs comma swap for thousands/decimals)

anil: hmm locale inversion. tokenizer?

maria: same token ids when comparing base vs merged, but logits favor `,` more in int4 artifact. fp16 merged artifact is fine.

quant-bot: qrun-id: qr-2026-03-22-11, quant-mode=int4-perchannel, leakage=0.009, tok-drift=0.017

lee: did you run an isolated prompt with deterministic sampling? beam can obscure root cause.

maria: yes minimal repro:
```
prompt = "Receipt total: 9876.54\nConfirm:"
for s in [1,2,3]:
  print(model_int4.sample(prompt, top_k=1, seed=s))
```
All three seeds produce comma output on int4; fp16 shows dot.

anil: possible culprits: per-channel scale rounding on positional layernorm output, or merge folding precision (we fold LoRA into base with fp16 accumulator then quantize).

sean: can you try two things: 1) merge in fp32 then quantize; 2) runtime apply LoRA (no offline fold) to see if ordering matters?

maria: doing both now, will post numbers.

(20m)

maria: results:
- fp32-merge + quantize -> flip rate 0.9%
- runtime-adapter (fp16 lora + int4 base) -> flip rate 0.15%

lee: ordering/precision during fold definitely amplifies quant error. customer prefers single artifact though.

anil: mitigation options: remerge with fp32 accumulators + per-channel symmetric quant + calibration on numeric tokens; or post-merge token bias correction for `.` vs `,` tokens; or increase quant buckets for problematic layers.

maria: tried per-channel symmetric + 512-sample calibration focused on invoice set -> 0.2% flip. pretty close to runtime-apply but still >0.15.

sean: for customer acceptance, propose making a `argo-int4-calibrated` artifact with attached eval pack (100 targeted receipts + 2k regression samples) and include reproducibility manifest + merge script. set numeric-format SLA <=0.25%

maria: uploading eval tarball to s3://redwood-evals/argo/argo-int4-cal-1810004322.tar.gz and opening an ENG-ML ticket with mitigation steps + owner.

lee: add a short runbook to the artifact: exact quant flags, calibration seed list, and a note that runtime adapters avoid artifact folding risk.

maria: done. pinging @anil for review before we share with SE. :thumbsup:

quant-bot: artifact notes appended: argo-int4-calibrated (bias-corr applied, per-channel symmetric)

anil: approved for share, schedule customer sync with SE.

sean: great triage team, please link ticket to customer onboarding checklist. :white_check_mark:
